subject: Proposed FY24 Municipal Budget
overview: The Medford City Council Committee of the Whole met to review proposed FY24 departmental budgets for several municipal offices. Department heads presented their budget requests and answered council inquiries regarding staffing, operations, and grant funding.

items.title: FY24 Budget Overview
items.summary: Council President Morell called the meeting to order to review proposed departmental budgets for FY24.

items.title: Treasurer and Collector FY24 Budget
items.summary: Treasurer-Collector Judy Johnston presented the department's $719,418 proposed budget and answered questions regarding tax title collection procedures and staffing levels.

items.title: Human Resources FY24 Budget
items.summary: Human Resources Director Lisa Crowley presented the $202,357 proposed budget, highlighting emergency responder hiring, insurance administration, and upcoming classification studies.

items.title: Elections Commission FY24 Budget
items.summary: Elections Manager Melissa Ripley and Election Commissioner Henry Miller presented the $340,196 proposed budget, addressing council concerns regarding a proposal to shift a clerk position to part-time.

items.title: Veteran Services FY24 Budget
items.summary: Director of Veteran Services Jeremy Johns presented the $435,703 proposed budget, detailing expanded VA claims accreditation capabilities and outreach efforts.

items.title: Assessor FY24 Budget
items.summary: Chief Assessor Ted Costigan presented the $559,637 proposed budget and responded to council questions regarding property valuations, personal exemptions, and tax levies.

items.title: Police Department and Traffic Supervisors FY24 Budget
items.summary: Police Chief Jack Buckley presented the department's $14,670,614 proposed budget, reviewing call volume trends, body-worn camera deployment, traffic enforcement, and school resource officers.

items.title: Planning, Development, and Sustainability FY24 Budget
items.summary: Director Alicia Hunt presented the $779,084 proposed budget, detailing departmental staffing, grant management, climate planning, and zoning initiatives.

items.title: Executive Office FY24 Budget
items.summary: Chief of Staff Nina Nazarian presented the $640,390 proposed budget, clarifying that the apparent line-item decrease reflected moving collective bargaining funds into a separate citywide account.

items.title: Law Department FY24 Budget
items.summary: Chief of Staff Nina Nazarian presented the Law Department's $552,403 proposed budget and answered questions regarding legal retainers and outside counsel expenditures.
